game_title: String Glue – Lava River Crossing Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the forge anvil using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the forge anvil is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 15.
